title: Customer name opens the customer
problem: There was no way from an order to the customer's history, dues and restrictions.
now: The customer's name on the order page opens their profile.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
